name: 3 leg dog pose
description: Downward dog with one leg lifted behind you. Stretches the back of the legs while building shoulder and hip stability.
instructions: Start in a high plank with your hands about shoulder-width apart.
Press through your hands and lift your hips up and back into downward-facing dog.
Lengthen your spine, then lift one leg behind you without forcing your hips to turn open.
Hold for a few steady breaths, lower the leg, and switch sides.
